registration_type: local timestamped preregistration; not a public registry

authorization.optuna_budget: 4 hours active computation per model; explicitly selected by user

claims_excluded: sensory intensity or calibrated human perception probabilities
statistical significance from three CV folds

dataset.label_selection: fixed development-frequency-only top 25; min support 30; existing selection preserved
dataset.zero_target_rows: retain all 381 development rows; do not filter based on scores
dataset.test_access: byte hashing and historical aggregate diagnostics only until Step 12

selection.objective: arithmetic mean over 3 folds of arithmetic mean of AP over all 25 labels
selection.ap_definition: non-interpolated sklearn average_precision_score; zero positive support -> AP 0, label retained
selection.candidate: highest finite objective among COMPLETE Optuna trials, all 3 folds and 25 labels present
selection.trial_exact_tie: lowest trial.number; verify explicitly before final fitting
selection.baseline_role: three fixed reference strategies per learner, reported separately; not added retrospectively to the final tuned-candidate pool
selection.no_gain_policy: If tuned CV is below baseline, report no observed tuning benefit; no extra trials or search-space expansion based on that result
selection.final_algorithm: compare the two selected tuned candidates by primary CV only; freeze both manifests before final test
selection.threshold: per-label F1 on fixed 808-row development holdout; unique predictions plus nextafter(max,+inf); ties atol 1e-12 -> higher threshold; positive if score >= threshold

partitions.initialization_gate: Step 5 regenerated primary splits must equal frozen indices exactly

imbalance.weighting: per-label negative/positive ratio computed on current training subset only
imbalance.random_oversample: whole multilabel rows; up to floor(0.5*n_training) extras; minority labels have imbalance ratio above mean present-label ratio; sample minority label then positive row; seed=primary_seed+fold
imbalance.forbidden: No resampling or fitted transformations on score/threshold/test

pruner.name: MedianPruner
pruner.reporting: cumulative mean macro AP after each complete all-label fold; step numbers 0,1,2

optimization.search_space_source: src/experiments.py::suggest_parameters; exact source snapshot and hash saved with protocol
optimization.baseline_parameters: empty override dictionary, pinned learner defaults; baseline values may lie outside the tuning space

budget.counting: N counts attempted trials including COMPLETE/PRUNED/FAIL. A killed RUNNING trial must be inspected and marked FAIL, never silently removed.
budget.minimum_rationale: 10 startup trials plus room for at least 10 further attempts; engineering floor, not a proof of convergence
budget.step5_gate: Require both valid smoke estimates, N>=20, t_hat for each learner <=960 seconds, and thermal smoke GO; otherwise STOP and record a resource-only amendment before tuning
budget.runtime_stop_rule: Stop at N attempts or 14400 active seconds, whichever first; do not increase caps based on CV/test. Both targets must be reached for a complete equal-attempt comparison; otherwise report resource-truncated comparison.
budget.session_rule: one additional trial per invocation; max 20 min; max 2 only after resource review; guard stop ends session
budget.failure_rule: Never extend N/time to replace failures automatically. Two consecutive resource-interrupted trials -> STOP to investigate; no automatic restart loop.
adequacy_reporting: best-so-far trajectory vs attempts and active time
all fold scores for complete trials
no global-optimum claim; a plateau is descriptive, not proof

smoke_measurement.label_rule: development prevalence ranks 1,13,25; sort by (positive_count,label); fixed before smoke
smoke_measurement.early_stopping: same primary fold stop, patience 50 and full learner round ceilings; fixed probe parameters
smoke_measurement.score_usage: measure predict duration only; no AP/F1 or parameter/model selection from smoke scores
smoke_measurement.required: nine completed label fits per learner within the shared smoke cap; interrupted/censored measurements do not yield a valid estimate
smoke_measurement.estimate_limitations: Planning estimate, not an upper-bound proof; no assumed 2x speedup from 1 to 2 threads. Cumulative/session guards still required.

sensitivity.parameters: primary selected trial frozen for each learner
sensitivity.rounds: per-label integer median primary best_iterations, same as final fitting
sensitivity.preprocessing: same primary selected imbalance recipe; current sensitivity training subset only
sensitivity.randomness: variant seed for learner and seed+fold for resampling
sensitivity.scaffold_groups: Murcko with chirality; empty scaffold is one group; train/score groups disjoint; GroupKFold 3 folds shuffle=True seed=42
sensitivity.scaffold_resolution: initial grouped early-stop holdout lacked apple/winey support; all sensitivities use merged train+stop with fixed rounds, including a new random-42 control
metrics: each fold macro AP and support
pooled out-of-fold macro AP over the same 4575 molecules
sensitivity.summary: mean and sample SD over three random seeds; paired descriptive differences per seed; scaffold contrasted with fixed-round random-42 control, not primary early-stopped CV
sensitivity.interpretation: conditional robustness of a selected recipe, not unbiased nested CV or unseen-scaffold external validation
sensitivity.failure_policy: No seed hunting, empty-scaffold splitting, label dropping, or selective reporting. Resource/code failures documented per variant before final-test access; unfinished variants receive no aggregate score.

final_evaluation.uncertainty: CV/seed variation descriptive; no p-value or significance claim from overlapping CV folds or three seeds

runtime.thermal_readiness: STOP until verified cool remeasurement and Step 4 GO
runtime.guard_type: cooperative callbacks; no independent OS watchdog
runtime.cooldown: per SAFE_EXECUTION_PLAN; not counted as active compute

amendments.rule: New version plus reason/time and before/after hashes; preserve v1. Methodology must not be amended based on final-test results.
amendments.after_smoke: Only resource-derived numeric N and resource feasibility are deferred to Step 5; selection metric/labels/seeds/spaces/sensitivity rules are already fixed.
amendments.local_freeze_limits: SHA-256 makes changes detectable, not physically impossible. No public-registry timestamp is claimed.
